action: Hold a public listening session at Millfield Community Center — not a town hall, not a press conference, something smaller and more honest. Invite anyone who has been laid off, anyone whose business is struggling, anyone who has been to a protest. My job is to listen for ninety minutes and then say out loud what I heard. Bring the task force chair. Bring the grant committee contact info. Let people see that the programs exist and that a human being is running them, not a form. I will specifically address the five active protests by acknowledging that the frustration is legitimate and the timeline of government response is inadequate. I will not promise things I cannot deliver. I will tell them what I have done, what is in motion, and what I am still fighting for.
